mapper.sql: id, name, parent_id, sort, icon, cover, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM category ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.sort, c.icon, c.cover, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.category_id = c.id) AS product_count FROM category c ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.sort, c.icon, c.cover, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.status = 1) AS online_count FROM category c ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, parent_id, sort, icon, cover, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{sort}, #{icon}, #{cover}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort = #{sort}, icon = #{icon}, cover = #{cover}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
